title: Agricultural Production Statistics in New Zealand
hook: This week we are exploring agriculture production statistics in New Zealand using data compiled from StatsNZ. Sheep have long outnumbered people in New Zealand, but the ratio of sheep to people peaked in the 1980s and has been in steady decline The gap between people and sheep in New Zealand is rapidly closing. There's now about 4.5 sheep to every person in New Zealand compared to a peak of 22 sheep per person in the 1980s, that's according to figures released by Stats NZ this week.
questions: Is sheep production unique in its decline? Do other types of meat production show the same pattern?
Which agricultural industries have shown the most production growth?

articles.name: Gap between people and sheep rapidly closing
